token.title: Existing Mobile Pass
token.description: Enter the credentials for Brivo's Mobile Pass app and your pass's refresh token. The app credentials must match the application that issued the token.

invitation.title: New Mobile Pass invitation
invitation.description: Enter the credentials for Brivo's Mobile Pass app, followed by your invitation email and code. Submitting this form activates the pass and uses the invitation.

error.invalid_auth: Brivo rejected the credentials. Check your client ID, client secret, and token or invitation.
error.cannot_connect: Setup could not finish. Check your connection, then submit the same details to try again.

abort.already_configured: This Mobile Pass is already configured.
abort.invitation_uncertain: This invitation was attempted, but no tokens were saved. Use an existing refresh token or request a new invitation.

check_connection.name: Check connection
check_connection.description: Check that Brivo accepts your credentials without opening a gate or door.

config_entry_id.name: Integration
config_entry_id.description: Choose a pass if you have more than one.
